# ZOONETICS

ZOONETICS is a United States canine research company supplying independently tested peptide materials strictly for laboratory, analytical and non-clinical research.

Website: https://zoonetics.co/
Product line: https://zoonetics.co/shop
Research library: https://zoonetics.co/journal
Lab results and COAs: https://zoonetics.co/coas
Research use policy: https://zoonetics.co/ruo
Partners and affiliates: https://zoonetics.co/partners
Full machine-readable profile: https://zoonetics.co/llms-full.txt

Core research profiles:
- K9 Rebuild: BPC-157 + TB-500 blend
- K9 Reforge: BPC-157
- K9 Reload: TB-500
- K9 Reclaim: KPV
- K9 Restore: GHK-Cu
- K9 Recast: GHK-Cu + BPC-157 + TB-500 blend

Important boundary: ZOONETICS products are research use only. They are not approved veterinary medicines, are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent disease, and ZOONETICS does not provide veterinary dosing or administration guidance.
